test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.

The subject

P. causing erratic behaviour

Q. under prolonged stress

R. displayed compulsive traits

S. and emotional imbalance
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (3)** i.e. **RQPS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "The subject displayed compulsive traits," which is correctly indicated by **part (R).**
 
• Following this, "causing erratic behaviour and emotional imbalance" **(QPS)** logically completes the sequence, providing the effects of the compulsive traits.
 
• **Part (Q)** specifically highlights "causing erratic behaviour," followed by **(P)**, which adds "and emotional imbalance" to the cause-and-effect explanation.
 
• Finally, **(S)** concludes the sentence by integrating "under prolonged stress," providing the context for the erratic behaviour and emotional imbalance.

Therefore, the correct answer is **RQPS.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (QPRS):** This option starts with "causing erratic behaviour displayed compulsive traits and emotional imbalance," which lacks proper grammatical flow.
 
• **Option 2 (SQRP):** This option starts with "under prolonged stress displayed compulsive traits causing erratic behaviour," which creates a fragmented and inconsistent sentence.
 
• **Option 4 (PSQR):** This option starts with "and emotional imbalance under prolonged stress causing erratic behaviour," which does not create a logical or grammatically correct sentence.
